answerEn:
The course will consist of four days a week in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, covering English language, aviation terminology, and ground training. This comprehensive training will ensure you complete all necessary flight training stages to obtain the required licenses.

Practical flight training will follow a flexible schedule, alternating between daytime and evening flights, conducted through our own schools or authorized training centers. Our instructors will be from Arab, American, British, and South African countries, depending on the level of training.

questionEn: How long does it take to study aviation?
answerEn:
The duration of flight training varies from one category to another depending on the needs of each trainee, as well as on passing the stages of training and the theoretical and practical tests. The expected time to complete the training is as follows:

From 16 months to 26 months, which may increase or decrease depending on the student's performance.

These are the typical flight training periods worldwide to obtain a pilot license. There is no advantage for a student who studies for a longer period at any academy over others. The most important thing is to obtain the pilot license regardless of the duration, and then pass the admission tests for airlines.

Regarding the location for practical flight training, we have numerous options for US flight schools we are affiliated with in various states. Students will discuss this with us upon enrollment to choose the option that best suits their preferences.

questionEn: What licenses will the student receive? And are they accredited in Saudi Arabia?
answerEn:
After completing all stages of aviation studies, the student will obtain three pilot licenses that qualify him to join airline companies: the Private Pilot License (PPL), the Instrument Rating (IR), and the Commercial Pilot License (CPL).

Trainees will receive licenses issued by the country of study, and these licenses are accredited by the Saudi General Authority of Civil Aviation and are recognized when returning to the Kingdom. Thus, the pilot will have two types of licenses: Saudi licenses recognized within the Kingdom, and internationally recognized licenses.

وسيحصلون المتدربين على رخص صادرة من دولة الدراسة وهذه الرخص معتمدة لدى هيئة الطيران المدني السعودي ويتم معادلتها عند الرجوع للمملكة وبالتالي يكون لدى الطيار نوعين من الرخص: رخص سعودية معتمدة داخل المملكة،ورخص معتمدة دوليا۔

The application will be reviewed immediately, and upon initial acceptance, the applicant will be contacted by phone, email, or another recognized method to schedule a personal interview.

Aviation Wings covers accommodation in the USA for the entire duration of the agreed-upon practical flight training program, according to each student's package. Upon completion of the program, the student is responsible for the remaining months' rent until graduation. Accommodation options are available at affordable prices for students.

Furthermore, any student who does not wish to complete the program may withdraw at any time and will receive a refund of the fees paid, minus any costs incurred up to the point of withdrawal.
